facts.claim: The deaths on Everest recorded from the first expedition to the end of 2025.

versions.note: Its members table holds 344 dead on Everest from 1921 to 2025, two of them in 1921, and its online report of Everest's dead counts the same 344.

source.title: The Himalayan Database, Autumn-Winter 2025

versions.note: From 1922 to 2025, by the Himalayan Database: 229 on the Nepal side and 110 on the Tibet side; 208 members and 130 hired, though its figures for the two sides add up to 131 hired.

source.title: Alan Arnette: Everest by the Numbers: 2026 Edition

facts.claim: The deaths on Everest in the spring 2026 season.

versions.note: Five, four of them while climbing; a Sherpa missing near Camp 3 from 29 May was found alive on 4 June.
